in_arabic.name: Mashriqi
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Easterner, resident of the East
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mashriqi هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'shr q', which means 'east' or 'direction of the sunrise'. Mashriqi refers to someone who is from the east or a resident of the eastern regions.
